headlines.title_cn: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt

headlines.summary_cn: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
